propositions: Enabled review-code fails to resolve the activated project prompt and exits with 'unknown prompt code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries'.
The known-prompts list contains only built-ins, so committed project prompts are not discovered.
Both attested-source and local-source review paths fail to resolve the committed project prompt from the repository root.
Expected behavior is that enabled review-code resolves committed project prompts and returns an actual review verdict.
Missing project prompt assets should still fail with a precise configuration error.
This is a duplicate of a closed bug already fixed by root-propagation repair threading the effective root through project-criterion discovery.
